entry.title: Salam is a general-purpose and systems programming language designed for efficient software development
entry.summary:
Welcome to Salam (سلام)
Salam (سلام — peace) is a friendly, easy-to-read programming language designed to welcome everyone into the world of tech. It is built to be fast and efficient while keeping code simple, clean, and accessible. Best of all, Salam breaks down traditional language barriers by letting you write your code in English, Persian (فارسی), or Arabic (العربية). Whether you want to build native software applications or quickly create websites using its built-in layout tools, Salam makes coding a welcoming experience. Getting started is incredibly easy, and you do not need a complicated setup to try it out. You can jump right in and test your ideas instantly using the browser-based web playground. If you prefer working locally on your own computer, you can download our official helper plugin directly from Visual Studio Marketplace to get helpful color-coding and editing support inside VS Code. Salam is a community-driven project, and we believe that a great project relies on friendly collaboration, kind teamwork, and shared learning. We would absolutely love for you to join us on this journey! Here are the 5 official links you can use to follow our progress, ask questions, or chat with other creators: Official Playground: Playground
VS Code Extension: VS Code Marketplace
Code & Collaboration: GitHub
Live Chat Server: Discord
Telegram Channel: Telegram

entry.summary: In a lot of release pipelines, the last messy step is still email. CI passes, health checks look fine, and then a signup message lands late, points at the wrong enviroment, or never arrives at all. That gap is small on paper, but it creates very real support pain.
